name: @indexnetwork/a2a
description: Agent2Agent (A2A) negotiation for personal agents: a client and server for negotiating on someone's behalf with another person's agent over the wire — collaborations, hiring, dating — with an LLM negotiator behind them.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/a2a/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --splitting && bun build ./src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --format esm && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
